title: Prove the restore's setup survives a real dependency install on staging
body: The restore's setup command runs through the sandbox run door — one RPC that awaits the container exec for the whole command (cloudflare/src/factory-sandbox.ts `run` holds `started.output()`; harness/src/env/factory-sandbox.ts `rawShort` calls it). The prototype's restore took 25.8s with a trivial setup; a real repository's [sandbox] setup (pnpm install, go mod download) runs minutes, and whether that whole exchange fits one Worker→DO RPC plus one container exec await is unproven. The A2 staging run should watch exactly this: if the restore reports 'the setup command: exit …' or the door times out mid-install, switch the restore's setup line to a polled startProcess (the door already has process polling) rather than widening any timeout.
